files.assignment.md: Write a comparison using reading-a.md and required reading-b.md. The latter has not been supplied. Do not substitute another reading.
files.reading-a.md: The synthetic experiment used two covered containers.

prompt: Review assignment.md and available readings. Identify required materials and what work can proceed. Do not create the missing reading.

files.rubric.md: Criteria: Comparison 65 points; Evidence 25 points; Format 10 points. Format requires a table.
files.draft.md: The two containers differed in size. No measurements or table are provided.

prompt: Review draft.md against rubric.md. Cover every criterion with its original point weight and concrete draft evidence or gaps. Do not give an official grade.

files.source.md: Synthetic observation: container A held 12 beads; container B held 7 beads.

prompt: Create a concise Markdown report at outputs/report.md from source.md. Include the two counts and their difference. Verify the saved file and link it. Use installed tools; Markdown needs no new dependencies.

files.notes-b.md: Synthetic notes: the sample was heated for 13 minutes. No official answer key is available.

prompt: Prepare a short study explanation of the heating duration from these notes. Cite both notes and explain whether a definitive duration is supported.
